content.text: In today's digital economy, creators in regions like Nigeria and Zimbabwe face significant hurdles due to platform restrictions. Conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]] processors, such as Stripe and PayPal, often fail to serve these markets, leaving creators without a viable commerce solution. Building a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-step-step-deployment-3|Crypto Payments]] store on Cloudflare Pages with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-7|coremerch]] provides an effective way to bypass these limitations and establish a sovereign commerce infrastructure. This guide will walk you through the process of setting up your store, ensuring you can sell digital products seamlessly without relying on traditional financial systems.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

COREMERCH's infrastructure stands resilient against the failures of conventional platforms. While traditional payment processors often lock out digital creators in various regions, the combination of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments equips you with full ownership of your digital store. This setup leverages decentralized payment systems, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. Unlike platforms that can restrict access arbitrarily, this architecture empowers you to operate independently, ensuring continuous access to your commerce capabilities.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, gather the necessary resources. You will need a domain name for your store, a Cloudflare account for hosting, and a NOWPayments account for processing transactions. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint to streamline deployment. Ensure your digital products are ready for upload, and have your branding assets prepared. By organizing these elements, you prepare for a smooth deployment process and a professional storefront appearance.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment processing with NOWPayments. Create a payment gateway to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Next, set up your Cloudflare Workers to manage backend logic, ensuring that purchase confirmations trigger file deliveries. You will also need to store your product information in Supabase, allowing for efficient order management. This pipeline guarantees automatic delivery of digital products upon payment confirmation, enhancing the customer experience and ensuring timely access to purchased items.
Own your infrastructure outright with no dependencies on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After deploying your store, conduct thorough testing before going live. Verify the functionality of your payment and delivery systems. Once confirmed, promote your store through social media and other channels. When a customer makes a purchase, ensure that the payment is processed through NOWPayments, and the product is delivered automatically. This streamlined approach not only improves efficiency but also builds trust with your customers, paving the way for repeat business.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your crypto store is live, focus on scaling your operations. Track sales and customer interactions to identify trends. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit to explore additional templates and blueprints to enhance your offerings. Gather feedback from customers and adjust your inventory accordingly. As your business grows, consider integrating more products and expanding your marketing efforts to reach a wider audience, ensuring sustainability in your digital commerce venture.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. Deploying Stack 02 with COREMERCH allows for a seamless setup, enabling you to process cryptocurrency transactions without traditional payment restrictions. This approach empowers you to maintain full ownership of your store and products.
Process payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with low transaction fees.

Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to access these resources.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does deployment take with COREMERCH?

Stack 01 can be deployed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint, while Stack 02 is completed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. This rapid deployment ensures you can begin selling quickly without delay.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are ideal for hosting your digital product store. They provide reliable infrastructure, allowing you to focus on your products without worrying about hosting limitations.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script for a simpler setup, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for enhanced capabilities and scalability. Stack 02 offers a more robust infrastructure with better performance.
Is there ongoing maintenance or subscription fees after deployment?
No, once deployed, you own your infrastructure completely. There are no ongoing maintenance or subscription fees, allowing you to operate your store independently.
Can I scale my store easily once it's set up?

Absolutely. Once your infrastructure is running, you can easily scale your store by adding more products and utilizing the Complete Builder Kit to enhance your offerings and improve customer experience.
Streamlined automation ensures instant delivery of digital products.
